title: From code to an editable diagram
subtitle: The workflow used by this skill. Cards, icons, text, and arrows stay editable.

nodes.title: Choose what to explain
nodes.description: Ask Codex for a workflow, architecture, or a specific feature's journey.

nodes.title: Trace the actual code
nodes.description: Read entry points and functions. Connect each important step to its source.

nodes.title: Describe the diagram
nodes.description: Prepare nodes, arrows, labels, icons, and positions as a JSON definition.

nodes.title: Generate a script
nodes.description: Bundle the definition, drawing code, and vector icons into one runnable .md file.

nodes.title: Run it in Obsidian
nodes.description: The Excalidraw Script Engine adds grouped cards and bound arrows to a drawing.

nodes.title: Edit and keep the result
nodes.description: Move shapes, rewrite labels, or ask Codex to update the existing drawing.

footer: Read 01 to 03 across the top, then 04 to 06 from right to left. Source labels refer to this repository.
